question: At equal headcount and equal structural unit quality, how much does formation experience change fractional losses and tactical exchange ratio for government and insurgent formations?

design.common_random_numbers: same engagement RNG seed across all 3x3 experience cells within each world-replicate

primary: probability government fractional loss < insurgent fractional loss
predictions: Holding insurgent experience fixed, increasing government E from .1 to .9 lowers government fractional losses and raises insurgent fractional losses.
Holding government experience fixed, increasing insurgent E from .1 to .9 symmetrically reverses those effects.
At equal opposing E, neither side receives an experience-only advantage; residual asymmetry may remain from actor/initiative mechanics and will be reported.
Analytic no-cap prediction for an E=.1 to E=.9 one-sided increase: own fractional loss multiplier ~0.8332, opponent ~1.2002, exchange-ratio multiplier ~1.4404.
guard: Synthetic matched-contact mechanism only; not an empirical casualty estimate.
